slot: Music and multi-venture founder: Motswako artist, festival, studio and label
name: Khuli Chana
trade: Musician; co-founder of Maftown Heights festival, founder of Khuli Chana Studios and the MyThrone label
location: Johannesburg and Midrand, Gauteng (Maftown Heights is rooted in Mahikeng)
why_wave: Verified ventures are a festival with no confirmed 2025/2026 edition, a 2022 studio and a 2021 label, and there is no published business-development route, so this is a relationship approach for later.
one_line_pitch: One WhatsApp front door for the enquiries and orders that Maftown Heights and your studio may generate, set up by hand and with no endorsement ask.

public_facts.fact: Maftown Heights was co-founded by Khuli Chana and Refiloe Ramogase, and Zkhiphani dates its inception to 2010; it celebrates Mahikeng, the birthplace of Motswako.

Music In Africa (2 October 2024) reported that Maftown Heights would return on 29 November (2024) at Mary Fitzgerald Square, Newtown, as a 'reunion edition', with Maglera Doe Boy as festival curator alongside co-founder Khuli Chana.
The same article says a four-part documentary series, Maftown Heights Untold Stories, premiered in June 2024.

LAMag's report on the 2024 edition (6 December 2024) says exclusive festival merchandise was available, mentions food offerings and a Legends Barber pop-up, and says the festival will return 'next year' (no date given).

Briefly (27 July 2022) reported that Khuli Chana had opened Khuli Chana Studios, described as a content creation hub for creatives with TV production facilities, sound, live streaming and music production.
Texx and the City (1 August 2022) reported the studio in Midrand as a content creation hub offering TV production, podcasting, music production, sound engineering, webinars, conferencing and events.
Daily Sun (15 April 2021) reported that he started his own record label, MyThrone, in partnership with Universal Music Group.
His official YouTube channel's About text gives separate booking and PR/interview email addresses at refram.co.za.
Golden Thread African Agency lists Khuli Chana on its talent page (footer dated 2026) with a bookings email and phone numbers.

businesses.what: Hip-hop and Motswako festival (co-founder); last confirmed edition 29 November 2024

businesses.what: Content creation hub in Midrand, launched 2022; 2026 trading not confirmed

channels_observed: Official YouTube channel with booking and PR email addresses in the About section (youtube.com/@KhuliChana/about)
Golden Thread African Agency talent page with a bookings route (goldenthreadagency.co.za/team-member/khuli-chana/)
Instagram, Facebook and X pages for the artist, festival and studio could not be read when opened; nothing recorded from them
decision_maker: Khuli Chana as co-founder of Maftown Heights and founder of the studio and label; first contact would realistically be his booking or management team (Refram or Golden Thread), who would decide whether to pass it on.

approach.route: No business-development route is published. The closest official routes are the bookings and press mailboxes on his official YouTube About page. A warm introduction is better. If using the bookings mailbox, say plainly that this is a business enquiry and ask to be pointed to the right person.
approach.contact_source: https://www.youtube.com/@KhuliChana/about (booking and press addresses only); https://goldenthreadagency.co.za/team-member/khuli-chana/ (agency bookings). Business-enquiry route: none found, needs warm intro.
approach.opening_message: Hello, this isn't a booking, it's about the business side of Khuli's ventures. I'm from FluxMuse, a new South African WhatsApp platform for businesses, and we set each one up by hand. Maftown Heights and the studio each seem to generate their own enquiries, and I'd like to ask how those are handled today. Could someone give me 20 minutes for a call? If this isn't relevant, tell me and I won't write again.
approach.compliance_note: A one-to-one, relevant business approach through the published management mailbox with a clear opt-out is a defensible route under POPIA s69; no personal numbers or guessed addresses are used.

pains.pain: Enquiries for the festival and studio bookings may land in different inboxes and DMs, and depend on whoever sees them first.
pains.evidence: You run two ventures with separate public faces (the festival and the studio), per the sources listed in this document. This is typical of multi-venture founders.
pains.validate_with: When someone asks about studio time, festival tickets or vendor slots, where does that message go and who answers it?

pains.pain: Each festival edition creates a spike of ticket, vendor and merch questions, with a long quiet period in between.
pains.evidence: The 2024 edition was announced as a 'reunion edition' and had merchandise on sale (Music In Africa, LAMag). We found no later edition.
pains.validate_with: How do you handle the weeks before an edition, and who runs the community afterwards?

pains.pain: Studio enquiries (TV, streaming, podcasting, music production) are quote-style and may need quick qualifying questions.
pains.evidence: Your studio offers several services (Briefly and Texx and the City, 2022). We saw no public booking form.
pains.validate_with: How do studio enquiries reach you today and how long does a first reply take?

pains.pain: Festival merchandise and the fan community may sit in social DMs with no order record.
pains.evidence: Merchandise was sold at the 2024 edition (LAMag). We found no online shop in the sources we could open.
pains.validate_with: Is merchandise sold outside edition days, and how do orders come in?

fit.revenue_potential: R499/month (Starter) for one venture; R1,999/month (Growth) if festival, studio and label are all set up; R0 if none is a live trading operation today
fit.reasoning: Real, documented ventures with a plausible multi-channel enquiry problem, but he is a high-profile artist with a management layer and no published business-enquiry route, so a cold approach will probably go to a bookings mailbox and stall. Only the festival (last confirmed 29 November 2024), the studio (2022) and the label (2021) are verified, and none is confirmed as trading in 2026. It could be a wasted approach if staff or an agency already handle all of this.

recommended_plan.why: Start with one venture, most likely the studio or the next festival edition, on Starter. That is enough until you know which venture needs more.
recommended_plan.upgrade_path: Growth if the festival, studio and label each need their own channel and page.

what_we_would_do.capability: WhatsApp Business setup: number, profile, templates, quick replies
what_we_would_do.for_them: A business number for the venture you choose, with saved replies for the questions it gets most: studio rates, festival info, merchandise availability.

what_we_would_do.capability: Hosted shop link with orders arriving on WhatsApp
what_we_would_do.for_them: A simple public page for merch, so orders arrive as a pre-typed WhatsApp message to your team's number.

what_we_would_do.for_them: Your team sends merch photos on WhatsApp and gets catalogue entries drafted for approval. Newly launched; no merchant has run it end to end yet.

what_we_would_do.capability: AI captions and images for posts (POST keyword)
what_we_would_do.for_them: Captions and images for festival and studio announcements, ready to forward to WhatsApp Status.
Festival announcements go only to people who opted in.

what_we_would_do.capability: Auto-publishing to Facebook Pages and Instagram
what_we_would_do.for_them: Meta permissions are not approved yet, so we would not rely on it.

actions: A 20-minute call to map where enquiries arrive for each of your ventures
Choose together the one venture where the pain is clearest and start there
Set up the WhatsApp Business number, profile and quick replies for that venture
Draft the top questions and answers with your team
Add a hosted shop link if merchandise is in scope; test with your team
Review real conversations and adjust replies
Review what was handled and what was missed
Decide together whether a second venture is worth adding

we_would_track: Time to first reply on enquiries
Enquiries that became a booking or order (as your team records them)

objections.objection: We have management and agencies for this.
objections.response: Understood. FluxMuse doesn't replace them; it would only give the business side a single inbox and saved answers. If management already covers it, we won't waste your time.
True. FluxMuse is new and is opening with a small first group that we set up by hand. We have no results to show, so we'd ask you to judge it on a working set-up rather than on our track record.

objections.objection: I don't want to endorse a platform.
objections.response: There is no endorsement ask. This is only a tool for your businesses, and nothing is published in your name.

gaps: Only three ventures are documented in a source we opened: Maftown Heights (co-founded, last confirmed edition 29 November 2024), Khuli Chana Studios (launched July 2022) and the MyThrone label (launched April 2021 with Universal Music Group). None is confirmed as trading or active in 2026.

No Maftown Heights edition after 29 November 2024 was found (searches for 2025 and 2026 returned nothing usable; LAMag only says it will return 'next year'). The festival's Instagram and Facebook pages could not be read.

REMOVED as unverified: My Throne Vodka and Motswako Originator Clothing. The only source is a generic StartUp Magazine list (10 July 2023) that we could not corroborate anywhere else; 'Motswakoriginator' is the title of his 2010 album, so the clothing claim may be a mix-up. Do not mention either in any message.
REMOVED: Khuli Chana Foundation and Raux Studios (Wikipedia lists 'Raw X Studios', not confirmed active). Wikipedia's khulichana.com website link did not load, so it is not cited.
Khuli Chana Studios' Facebook page returned an error when opened, so the earlier claim quoting its description was removed. The studio's Midrand location comes from Texx and the City (2022) only.
The YouTube About text and Golden Thread page were both read, but which of Refram or Golden Thread currently manages him is unconfirmed. Both routes are for bookings and PR, not business development.
Music In Africa dates the reunion edition to 29 November; LAMag's report is dated 6 December 2024. We treat 29 November 2024 as the event date.
Bathu Shoes is deliberately not mentioned. Personal details in sources (marriage, net-worth articles) were deliberately not recorded.
